page_title: NIC 1-2 MNT | Nice v Montpellier 08/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' The corner from Tom Louchet (Nice) is hurriedly cleared.

90+4' Close! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.

90+3' Benjamin Lecomte pulls off a great save to deny Evann Guessand (Nice), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' It will be a corner kick for Nice.
90+3' Dante (Nice) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
90+1' Leo Leroy (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Ruddy Buquet and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
88' Now Montpellier have a corner.
87' Francesco Farioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) replacing Hicham Boudaoui.
85' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) prepares to take a corner kick.
84' Evann Guessand (Nice) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
82' Evann Guessand (Nice) makes a strong challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul. Montpellier earn a free kick.
81' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Arnaud Nordin is replaced by Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mousa Al-Tamari leaves the pitch and Akor Adams (Montpellier) comes on.
79' Benjamin Lecomte blocks Dante (Nice)'s effort from the edge of the box.
77' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
77' Evann Guessand (Nice) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
75' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' Khephren Thuram comes off the pitch to be replaced by Morgan Sanson (Nice).
73' A substitution has been made. Gaetan Laborde goes off and Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) comes on.
72' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
72' Nice win a corner.
71' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
70' Khephren Thuram (Nice) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
69' That will be all from Wahbi Khazri who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Christopher Jullien (Montpellier).

68' The opposition can't get near Evann Guessand (Nice), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
64' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Nice have a free kick.
61' Ruddy Buquet couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Nice in a dangerous position.
58' The substitution is prepared. Tom Louchet (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jordan Lotomba.
58' Francesco Farioli is forced to make a change. Pablo Rosario (Nice) is unable to continue due to injury, Evann Guessand comes on.

57' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
55' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
54' Pablo Rosario (Nice) makes a rough challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul. Montpellier are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
52' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

50' The game is interrupted. Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick is awarded to Nice.
49' Jeremie Boga (Nice) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
47' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ruddy Buquet had an easy-decision to make.
46' Michel Der Zakarian makes a switch. Leo Leroy (Montpellier) is coming on in place of Joris Chotard at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Ruddy Buquet starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Melvin Bard (Nice) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
45+4' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) makes a slide tackle, but referee Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul. Nice earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
45+3' Melvin Bard (Nice) is able to continue to play.
45+2' Melvin Bard (Nice) picks up an injury.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Melvin Bard (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul. Montpellier will take a free kick.
42' 1 - 2 Goal! Teji Savanier (Montpellier) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marcin Bulka into right side of the goal.
42' The referee gives a yellow card to Pablo Rosario (Nice) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
42' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is going to take the penalty!
40' The Montpellier players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
40' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Montpellier! Let's see what he decides.
39' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
38' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) whips in a vicious corner direct on goal, but the keeper makes a confident catch on the line.
38' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is about to take a corner kick.

37' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

35' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards low towards the middle of the goal, but Marcin Bulka is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
33' Melvin Bard (Nice) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
32' Jeremie Boga (Nice) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
30' Jeremie Boga (Nice) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

29' Khephren Thuram (Nice) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice.

28' Khephren Thuram (Nice) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
26' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Montpellier.
25' Terem Moffi (Nice) commits a rough foul. Ruddy Buquet stops the game and makes a call. Free kick. Montpellier will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
22' Montpellier earn a corner.

22' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Montpellier.
19' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Nice get a free kick.
18' Ruddy Buquet has a clear sight and sees a foul from Melvin Bard (Nice). Montpellier have a free kick.

16' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
14' Dante (Nice) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ruddy Buquet no option but to blow his whistle. Montpellier are awarded the free kick.
13' Problems for Michel Der Zakarian as Silvan Hefti is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) replaces him.
13' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' 1 - 1 Gaetan Laborde launches a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Jeremie Boga (Nice) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. 1:1.

10' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box from the corner but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 0:1.
10' Montpellier force their opponents to concede a corner.
10' An attempted cross from Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) is cleared. Montpellier force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
5' Melvin Bard (Nice) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Benjamin Lecomte.
3' A pass from Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is intercepted by Benjamin Lecomte and the move breaks down.
2' The Nice players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nice will kick-off.
Ruddy Buquet got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
